rules.height_reference: Median of previously accepted heights at f-30 <= prior_frame < f. During startup use global player/point median until accepted evidence spans >=8 source frames (original five 2F samples). If rolling history is empty, use global median.
rules.height_reset: Consecutive raw height rejections, missing raw samples do not break run (056 rule). Retrospectively reconsider run, replace height history, retain speed rejection from previous accepted and adjacent raw points, including entry/return.
rules.smoothing: Separate, frozen-input x/y medians in inclusive +/-8F window in runs with accepted gaps <=30F. Window must span >=4F (original three 2F samples); no recursive updates, one-sided end windows allowed.
rules.interpolation: Linear between smoothed accepted endpoints, every source frame. status is final; filter_status preserves rejection before interpolation.
rules.wrist: Both same-side players need >=1 finite nonnegative wrist_speed. Unique larger peak >=1.3*smaller; both zero/ties undecided. No guessed replacement.
rules.side_outside: Consecutive source frames, no bridging missing values; duration=(end-start)/59.94 >=1. Report cleaned positions and raw proxies separately over full exported point span.
rules.legacy_height_rules_apply_to: near_* and frozen pre-link B geometry only

lift.correct_position: far depth only, review2; x unchanged

far_depth.occlusion: same-frame near/far horizontal overlap >= 0.10 * far width AND near y1 < far y2; no height ratio
far_depth.depth: Nearest accepted unoccluded y2 before/after within the same fixed person and rally; linear in source frame; unlimited gap; one side held; neither missing
far_depth.x: current box centre x; project (x, depth_y_px) with unchanged tracking homography
far_depth.anchor_selection: Iterate speed filtering and accepted unoccluded depth anchors to a fixed point; anchors refer to final filter_status=observed, before smoothing
far_depth.limitation: Occluded depth is interpolation, not observation; forward/backward motion during occlusion is invisible

review2.offscreen_hold: last valid observation in the same rally only
review2.identity_reentry: last observation gap strictly > FPS source frames: vacant slot; otherwise original time/distance gate; minimum total distance

far_depth_envelope.shift_definition: raw projected court_y minus envelope projected court_y, metres; potential input shift also recorded on occluded/overridden/rejected rows
far_depth_envelope.applied_definition: unoccluded, height-eligible, accepted observation, no serve/lift override, envelope_shift_m > 1e-9

review2b_checks.visual_assessment: サーブの跳躍・着地に伴う足元上昇が見える。明確な後退は判別できず、包絡は着地側の深さを用いる。
横移動を伴う前進・踏み替えが見える。包絡は後の接地位置を先取りし、短い前後変動を抑える可能性あり。
前進を伴う走行・足の上げ下げが見える。明確な後退は見えないが、包絡は後の接地位置を先取りする。
打球に伴う片足支持・跳躍状の姿勢と着地が見える。後退抑制の有無は3静止画では確定できない。
横移動と踏み替え、足元の小さな下方向変化が見える。包絡線が見える靴より下に出るため過補正の可能性を残す。

review2b_visual_review_method: Assistant visual inspection of the five original-video start/mid/end enlarged image panels; qualitative, no independent foot labels

review2c_p07_F1_above_intervals.cause_estimate: 下隠れの深さアンカー補間が主体。F23672はF23643/23742を参照。アンカー枠の足元偏り・実後退の可能性
